exposure: rheumatic heart disease and mitral stenosis
cohort: 48 parturients with rheumatic heart disease and mitral stenosis who underwent cesarean section deliveries with epidural anesthesia at Union Hospital, Fujian Medical University (Fuzhou, China) from January 2002 to December 2012
finding: Epidural anesthesia can be safely and effectively used for cesarean section in pregnant women with rheumatic heart disease and mitral stenosis, resulting in increased hemodynamic parameters during delivery but no maternal mortalities.
mod_finding: The study focused on epidural anesthesia management for cesarean sections in pregnant women with rheumatic heart disease and mitral stenosis and did not compare different modes of delivery.
